steps.title: Gather materials and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all listed consumables and chemicals, including Falcon tubes (15 ml, 50 ml), 1.5 ml screw‑cap and Eppendorf tubes, 96‑well plate, porcine trehalase (Sigma T8778), Aspergillus niger amyloglucosidase (Sigma 10115), glucose assay kit (Sigma GAGO20), sodium carbonate, glacial acetic acid, sodium acetate, sulfuric acid, 0.25 M sodium carbonate (50 ml), 1 M glacial acetic acid (50 ml), 0.2 M sodium acetate pH 5.2 (50 ml), 12 N sulfuric acid (25 ml), rich and synthetic minimal media, reverse‑phase HPLC column (Synergi 4 µm Fusion‑RP 80A), HPLC‑grade methanol, water, [U‑13C6] glucose, [U‑13C4] aspartate, trehalose standard, acetonitrile, ammonium acetate, ethanol, 25 % acetonitrile/5 mM ammonium acetate, 60 % methanol (100 ml), 75 % ethanol (10 ml).

steps.title: Grow cultures for enzymatic assay
steps.instruction: Inoculate yeast into either rich medium (Recipe 8) or synthetic minimal medium (Recipe 9) and incubate at 30 °C until logarithmic phase.

steps.title: Harvest cells for enzymatic assay
steps.instruction: Measure culture optical density and collect cells corresponding to ~10 A₆₀₀ (≈10 × 10⁶ cells) per sample; transfer to a 15‑ or 50‑ml Falcon tube, centrifuge at 3 000 × g for 3 min, discard supernatant, wash pellet with 1 ml ice‑cold water in a 1.5 ml screw‑cap tube, centrifuge at maximum speed for 15 s, remove supernatant with a pipette or vacuum syringe, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Alkali lysis and pH adjustment
steps.instruction: Resuspend each frozen pellet in 0.25 ml 0.25 M sodium carbonate, incubate at 95‑98 °C for 4 h (dry block or water bath with occasional mixing). Then add 0.15 ml 1 M glacial acetic acid and 0.6 ml 0.2 M sodium acetate to bring the suspension to pH 5.2; mix gently to avoid vigorous CO₂ evolution.

steps.title: Enzyme digestion of trehalose and glycogen
steps.instruction: Add trehalase to a final activity of 0.05 U ml⁻¹ for trehalose samples and amyloglucosidase to 1‑2 U ml⁻¹ for glycogen samples. Incubate tubes with constant rotation overnight at 37 °C for trehalose digestion or at 57 °C for glycogen digestion.

steps.title: Collect digested supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at maximum speed at room temperature for 3 min, carefully transfer the clear supernatant to a fresh 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Glucose oxidase assay
steps.instruction: In a 96‑well plate, add either 0.04 ml undiluted supernatant or a 1:1 or 1:4 dilution (in triplicate). Add 0.08 ml reconstituted glucose oxidase/peroxidase/o‑dianisidine reagent, incubate at 37 °C for 30 min, stop the reaction with 0.08 ml 12 N sulfuric acid, and read absorbance at 540 nm. Determine glucose concentration from a standard curve.

steps.title: Prepare metabolite extracts (steady‑state)
steps.instruction: Grow yeast in rich or minimal medium at 30 °C to logarithmic phase, harvest 6‑10 A₆₀₀ (≈6‑10 ml culture). Quench metabolism by adding 4 volumes of 60 % methanol pre‑cooled to –40 °C to –45 °C and incubate 5 min on ice. Centrifuge at 1 000 × g for 3 min at –5 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 0.7 ml cold 60 % methanol (‑45 °C), transfer to 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube, centrifuge again at 1 000 × g for 3 min at –5 °C. Remove supernatant with a pipette, resuspend pellet in 1 ml 75 % ethanol, heat at 80 °C for 3 min with intermittent vortexing, place on ice 5 min, centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 min at room temperature, transfer 0.96 ml supernatant to a new tube, centrifuge at maximum speed for 10 min at room temperature, split 0.45 ml supernatant into two fresh tubes, dry in a vacuum dryer for 3‑4 h and store at –80 °C.

substeps.instruction: Grow cells to log phase at 30 °C.
Quench with 4 volumes of –40 °C to –45 °C 60 % methanol for 5 min.
Resuspend pellet in 0.7 ml cold 60 % methanol, transfer to 1.5 ml tube.
Heat at 80 °C for 3 min with vortex, then ice 5 min.
Centrifuge max speed 1 min RT; transfer 0.96 ml supernatant.
Centrifuge max speed 10 min RT; split 0.45 ml into two tubes.
Dry under vacuum 3‑4 h; store at –80 °C.

steps.title: LC‑MS/MS trehalose quantification
steps.instruction: Prepare a trehalose stock of 0.25‑1 µg ml⁻¹ so that 5‑10 ng is injected per run; make serial dilutions to cover 1‑50 ng on‑column. Dissolve each dried extract in 0.05‑0.5 ml of solvent (25 % acetonitrile/5 mM ammonium acetate, Recipe 7) depending on expected concentration, inject onto the Synergi RP‑80A column, and analyze by negative‑mode MS/MS as described in Walvekar et al., 2018.

steps.title: 13C‑glucose labeling experiment
steps.instruction: Grow cells at 30 °C in rich or minimal medium to log phase, then add [U‑13C6] glucose to obtain a 50 % unlabeled : 50 % labeled mixture (e.g., add 2 % labeled glucose to a culture already containing 2 % unlabeled glucose). Incubate on a rocking platform for ≤5 min, harvest 6‑10 ml of culture at A₆₀₀ ≈ 1, and process the cells using the metabolite‑extract protocol (Step 8).

steps.title: 13C‑aspartate labeling experiment
steps.instruction: Grow cells in a non‑glucose carbon source (glycerol/ethanol) or in glucose‑limited/late‑log conditions, add [U‑13C4] aspartate to a final concentration of 1 mM, incubate for ~15 min (earliest time point), harvest 6‑10 ml of culture at A₆₀₀ ≈ 1, and follow the metabolite‑extract protocol (Step 8).

steps.title: Normalize MS/MS data
steps.instruction: Normalize across samples by (i) extracting metabolites from equal cell numbers and injecting identical volumes, (ii) spiking an internal standard such as a labeled or unnatural disaccharide (e.g., melibiose) during extraction, and/or (iii) scaling by total ion count for each injection.

steps.title: Prepare required solutions (recipes)
steps.instruction: Make solutions as follows: 0.25 M sodium carbonate – dissolve 1.32 g in 50 ml sterile water; 1 M glacial acetic acid – add 2.87 ml glacial acetic acid to 47.13 ml sterile water; 0.2 M sodium acetate pH 5.2 – dissolve 0.82 g in 50 ml sterile water, adjust pH and filter‑sterilize; 12 N sulfuric acid – add 8.33 ml concentrated H₂SO₄ to 16.7 ml sterile water; 60 % methanol – mix 40 ml methanol with 60 ml water, keep at –45 °C; 75 % ethanol – mix 7.5 ml ethanol with 2.5 ml water, store at room temperature; 25 % acetonitrile/5 mM ammonium acetate – combine 25 ml acetonitrile, 38.5 mg ammonium acetate, 75 ml water, filter‑sterilize; Rich medium – 1 % yeast extract, 2 % peptone, 2 % glucose; Synthetic minimal medium – 0.67 % yeast nitrogen base, 2 % glucose (± amino acids).
